nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in constructor and updated by ownership transfer.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
shares.symbol public token symbol string, set in constructor to 'srh1'.
shares.name public token name string, set in constructor to 'shares token'.
shares.decimals public token decimals (0).
shares._totalSupply total token supply, minted to the deployer address in constructor.
shares.balances mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
shares.allowed mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): addition with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender (privileged initialization).
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages new owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then flips owner.
shares constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals/supply and pre-mints balance to the fixed deployer address.
shares.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] (unchecked subtraction).
shares.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
shares.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits 'to' using SafeMath.
shares.approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender].
shares.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and decrements allowance.
shares.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
shares.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on spender.
shares fallback function: payable, always reverts, rejects ETH.
shares.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to arbitrary token contract.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership, balances and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary attacker-controlled address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(); Solidity 0.4.x wraps without revert, allowing underflow.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender without restriction.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body runs.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender as the from argument to the external receiveApproval call.
Constructor writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the privileged newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner gate protects the ownership transfer entry point.
acceptOwnership reassigns the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership validates against the newOwner state variable and resets it.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply performs unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates addition to SafeMath.safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.safeSub for balance and allowance math.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient credit.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call (state written before call).
approveAndCall triggers an external call to the caller-supplied spender contract's receiveApproval.
Malicious spender contract can reenter transfer during the receiveApproval callback.
Reentrancy into approveAndCall/allowance logic is possible from the untrusted callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary tokenAddress contract.
transferAnyERC20Token sends tokens to the owner and is gated by onlyOwner.
The called token contract can reenter shares while transferAnyERC20Token is executing.
